exclusions.scope: Exact full source messages explicitly present in the12 retained protocols. No generated full target translations or isolated query fragments were added. The original protocol source/target wording is broader than the implemented and frozen source-message set.

support: Distinct connected corpus components, not independently documented articles. Repeated occurrences within one pair/component still contribute to lexical-score means; no confidence calibration.
dictionary: Complete-unit records deliberately retain ineligible, unsafe, POS/number and alternative-sense analyses. Shared sense IDs are corroboration only, never automatic native eligibility or contextual correctness.
tokenization: Historical training tokenizer can omit underscore gaps and split combining marks or literals. Original full text and exact offsets remain. Statistical token geometry is not native-safe selection; later selection must apply native complete-token and protected-literal rules.
independent_structural_review: Android agent independently enumerated23136 many-to-many consistency/cap/stop-punctuation cases; all matched reference expectations. This is geometry evidence, not translation accuracy.

original_text_identity.text: Exact retained SQLite representative, not necessarily verbatim text of each linked TMX unit.
original_text_identity.upstream_import: PGV importer NFC/whitespace-normalizes and casefold-deduplicates endpoints, keeping first representative text; later archive/unit evidence can reference normalized-equivalent spelling.
original_text_identity.offsets: Exact for the retained source/target representative strings; raw TMX casing/spelling is not reconstructed.
original_text_identity.semantic_limit: Case/proper-name review must account for this normalization; archive/unit provenance remains retained.
